# Step - range

`range` · category: [Filters](../../traversal/step_reference.md#filters)

Passes on the traversers from position low (inclusive) to high (exclusive); with Scope.local inside each collection.

## Forms

```text
range(arg1: i64, arg2: i64)
range(arg1: Scope, arg2: i64, arg3: i64)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v().values("name").range(1, 3).to_list()   // ["vadas", "lop"]
```
